name: disabled
label: Disabled
description: Set to prevent the user from interacting with the field. The field appears grayed out

name: readonly
label: Read-only
description: When set, the user cannot modify the value of the input field. The input field is not disabled in this setting

name: autofocus
label: Auto-focus
description: Set to automatically place focus inside the input on page load

name: value
label: Value
description: The value of the input field. Unless the input field has pre-populated data, leave this property empty

name: manageValue
label: Manage value
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the value property. Use the value set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: name
label: Identifier
description: Reference name for the input field

name: placeholder
label: Placeholder text
description: Placeholder text for the input field. This text should hint to the user what input is expected

name: disableUnmask
label: Disable show password option
description: Set to disable the user's ability to view the password value in plain text using a 'mask'/'unmask' button

name: requirements
label: Requirements
description: Array of requirements for the user-entered password. Each requirement must contain a label describing the requirement and the RegEx pattern against which the password must validate

name: compact
label: Place password requirements in icon
description: Set to display password requirements in the input field popover instead of below the input field. Validation errors for passwords that fail to meet requirements appear below the input field

name: label
label: Label
description: Field label to tell users what to enter in the field

name: wrapLabel
label: Wrap label
description: Wraps the label if it does not fit on one line

name: required
label: Required
description: Set to indicate that the user must enter a value in the input field before proceeding

name: hideRequiredIndicator
label: Hide required indicator
description: Set to hide the required indicator. Use this for forms where most fields are required, along with the `optional` flag for any fields that are not required

name: optional
label: Optional
description: Set to indicate that the user does not have to enter a value in the input field before proceeding

name: helperContent
label: Helper content
description: If set, an iconic button with popover appears next to the field label for displaying additional hint text to the user, such as password requirements or other instructions for completing the field. Use plain text to allow the text to be translatable

name: invalid
label: Invalid
description: When set, the field appears invalid indicating incorrect input

name: manageInvalid
label: Manage invalid
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the invalid property. Use the invalid set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: messages
label: Alert messages
description: Array of inline alert messages that display below the field

name: configAria
label: ARIA properties
description: Configures ARIA properties

name: align
label: Text align
description: Alignment of the text within the field

name: fieldLayout
label: Field layout configuration
description: Configuration for the field layout. Determines whether the labels, field and slotted content are arranged vertically or horizontally, and their respective proportion in a horizontal container

name: landmark
label: Landmark
description: Allow the Landmark Focus keyboard shortcut to focus this input
